title: Statistics
label: Statistics
checked: Predictions with confidence intervals, marginal means with confidence intervals, and random-effect conditional modes and standard deviations. Identical model formulas and data across implementations.
description: scripts/evidence/r-references.R fits the models in R and lme4 and writes tests/fixtures/r-references.json. scripts/evidence/parity.php fits the same models with phit, passes the fits to predictions(), marginal_means(), and random_effects_plot(), and compares the results value by value.
reference: R 4.6.1: lm(), predict(); lme4 2.0.6: lmer(), ranef(condVar = TRUE)

comparison.applies_to: Numerical results; fits, quantiles, intervals, and polygon points
Mixed-model conditional modes and standard deviations; dependent on the REML optimum

cases.name: mtcars, mpg ~ wt + hp + factor(cyl)
cases.quantity: predictions on a 9-row grid: estimate, lower, upper

cases.name: mtcars, mpg ~ factor(cyl) + factor(am) + wt

exclusions: The fits come from phit-polyfill; the cases test phiz's helpers together with phit's fits. phit's fits are verified separately.
Marginal means are compared with the emmeans formula computed directly in R; the emmeans package is not used.
